preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some NOMOS tokens to initiate transfer
Contract must have accumulated ETH balance from previous token swaps (swapAndLiquify must have been triggered)

exploit_hint: The contract has a reentrancy vulnerability in the swapAndLiquify function due to unsafe external calls. Create a malicious contract that implements a fallback/receive function. When swapAndLiquify is triggered (by selling tokens to the pair), the contract will call addLiquidity which makes an external ETH transfer via uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH. The attacker's contract can re-enter during the ETH transfer and call swapAndLiquify again before state updates, potentially draining ETH from the contract. The attack requires: 1) Deploy malicious contract with reentrant fallback, 2) Trigger swapAndLiquify by selling tokens to uniswapV2Pair when contract has accumulated enough tokens, 3) Re-enter during addLiquidity to exploit the reentrancy.
